entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.2.0** - **GUIDE page**: the pink-noise method one tap per track. Pull your faders down and tap **NEXT**: the noise comes on and the guide names each part of your beat in turn (kick, snare / clap, bass, hi-hats, percussion, main sample / chords, melody / lead, vocals, pads / texture, FX), with what to listen for. entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.0.2
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could switch the noise on for a moment. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was ON/OFF. That first slot now does nothing; ON/OFF is a new parameter at the end (same switch, same Q-Link). Saved projects open as before.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialNoise 2.0.0**, the first public release (the renamed, re-styled Pink Noise). A calibrated pink noise reference for mixing: one-tap RMS levels, mono or stereo, full or limited range, and a live meter. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialnoise#readme) for how to use it. **Download** `PotentialNoise-2.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below.
